Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    return G
G=load()

from collections import Counter
def solve(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=0: cnt[(r,c,v)]+=1
    # detect vertical line: column c where many rows share same nonzero value spanning a long segment
    colcnt=Counter()
    for c in range(w):
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(h) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if len(vals)>h//3: colcnt[c]+=1
    # choose line col: max total nonzero in column, value = most common there
    line=None; best=-1
    for c in range(w):
        vals=[g[r][c] for r in range(h) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if not vals: continue
        cc=Counter(vals)
        v,n=cc.most_common(1)[0]
        if n>len(vals)//2 and n>best: best=n; line=(c,v)
    L,v=line
    # pattern rows: rows where cell at L is v and other nonzero cells form contiguous run(s)
    pat=[]
    for r in range(h):
        if g[r][L]==v:
            nz=[(c,g[r][c]) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=0 and c!=L]
            if nz: pat.append((r,nz))
    # isolated marker rows: rows where cell at L is v and NO other nonzero (or sparse)
    mark=[]
    for r in range(h):
        if g[r][L]==v and not any(g[r][c]!=0 for c in range(w) if c!=L):
            mark.append((r,g[r][0]))
    # pattern bounding rows
    pr=[p[0] for p in pat]
    mr=[m[0] for m in mark]
    ptop=min(pr); pbot=max(pr); ph=pbot-ptop+1
    mtot=min(mr); mbot=max(mr)
    # build output: each marker row r gets pattern row (r-mtot)%ph offset from ptop, full width, keeping marker? check demos
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (r,m) in mark:
        off=(r-mtot)%ph
        rowpat=g[ptop+off][:]
        # align: pattern left edge maps to...? in demos pattern left = L (line col). place pattern starting at line col? check
        out[r]=rowpat[:]
    # remove markers not covered? keep original line pattern rows
    return out

def solve(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # detect marker column: leftmost column containing non-zero values in many rows

    return out

    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # marker column: most common nonzero column count (leftmost tie)
    best=(-1,0); L=None
    for c in range(w):
        n=sum(1 for r in range(h) if g[r][c]!=0)
        if n>best[0]: best=(n,c); L=c
    # pattern rows: rows with nonzero beyond L
    pat=[r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][c]!=0 for c in range(L+1,w))]
    p0=min(pat); p1=max(pat)
    A=g[p0][:]; B=g[p1][:]
    # markers: rows where the only nonzero left of/at L is the marker cell itself (pattern rows excluded)
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[0]*w
        # determine which pattern row
        if g[r][L]!=0 and r not in pat:
            P = A if ((r-p0)%2==0) else B
            # copy marker (kept), then pattern shifted to start right of marker, then extend next cell to edge
            nxt = None
            for c in range(w):
                if c>L and g[r][c]!=0 and not any(g[x][c]!=0 for x in range(h)):
                    nxt=g[r][c]
            P=L+nxt  # placeholder
            out.append([g[r][L]] + list(P[L+1:w]) + ( [nxt]*(w-L-1-len(P[L+1:w])) if nxt else [] ))
        else:
            out.append(g[r][:])
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    pred=solve(gi)
    print(k, pred==go, pred if pred!=go else '')

def f(gi):
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    nzrows=[r for r in range(h) if any(x!=0 for x in g[r])]
    Q=max(nzrows); P=nzrows[-2]  # template (densest row), anchor row for parity
    lA=min(c for c in range(w) if g[Q][c]!=0)
    A=[g[Q][c] for c in range(lA,w)]
    lB=min(c for c in range(w) if g[P][c]!=0)
    B=[g[P][c] for c in range(lB,w)]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(h):
        pos=[c for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if not pos: continue
        mc=pos[0]
        T=A if ((r-P)%2==0) else B
        row=[0]*w; row[mc]=g[r][mc]
        for i,x in enumerate(T):
            if mc+1+i<w: row[mc+1+i]=x
        se=mc+len(T)
        extras=[x for x in g[r][se+1:w] if x!=0]
        if extras:
            v=extras[0]
            for cc in range(se+1,w): row[cc]=v
        out[r]=row
    return out

import json

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    nonzero_rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c]!=0 for c in range(W))]
    sp=max(nonzero_rows)
    # template = consecutive run ending at the bottom
    tm_start=max(r-1 for r in nonzero_rows if any(g[r][c]!=0 and c!=min([c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c]!=0 for r in range(H) and c!=c] )) or True) for r in nonzero_rows)
    # simpler: bottommost rows with nonzero = template
    cand=[g[r][:] for r in nonzero_rows]
    tr=[g[r][:] for r in nonzero_rows if r>=nonzero_rows[-1]-3 and g[r][-1]!=0][:2]  # grab bottom rows with nonzero last col
    # pragmatic: template rows = the last consecutive group of rows whose LAST cell is nonzero
    grp=[]
    for r in reversed(nonzero_rows):
        if not grp or g[r][W-1]==0: break
        grp.append(r)
    tmpl=grp[::-1]
    marks=[r for r in nonzero_rows if r not in tmpl]
    marks.sort()
    n=len(tmpl)
    for r in marks:
        mc=[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if mc:
            mcol=g[r][mc[0]]
            out[r][mc[0]:]=list(out[r][:])
            out[r][mc[0]]=mcol
            for c in range(mc[0]+1,W): out[r][c]=mcol
        ti=(r-min(marks))%n
        res=list(tmpl[ti])
        if g[r][mc[0]]!=0: res[mc[0]]=g[r][mc[0]] if False else None
        # keep original spine cell value if the marker row had an off-spine cell -> overwrite; else keep spine
        res[mc[0]]=g[r][mc[0]] if mc else None
        # if row had no off-spine cell, keep original spine cell
        if not mc:
            pass
        out[r]=res
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # spine column: column with the highest nonzero count
    sc=max((sum(1 for rr in range(H) if g[rr][c]!=0) for c in range(W)),key=lambda c: sum(1 for rr in range(H) if g[rr][c]!=0))
    tmax=max(r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c]!=0 for c in range(W)))
    nzc=[[g[r][c] for c in range(W) if c!=sc and g[r][c]!=0] for r in range(H)]
    cands=[r for r,n in enumerate(nzc) if len(n)>=2]
    tmplrows=cands[-1::-1]  # bottom-up; trim leading (bottommost) ones that don't connect contiguously
    tmplrows=[x for x in tmplrows[:-1] if cands[cands.index(x)-1]==x-1]+[tmplrows[-1]] if len(cands)>1 else cands
    n=len(tmplrows)
    mm=min(tmplrows)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r,nz in zip(range(H),nzc):
        if nz==cands or False: pass
        if len(nz)>=2: continue  # template row itself
        ti=(r-mm)%n
        tmpl=g[tmplrows[ti]]
        for c in range(W):
            if c==sc: continue
            out[r][c]=tmpl[c]
    return out
ok=True
for k in ['Demo pair '+str(i) for i in [1,2,3,4]]:
    p=f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    ok&=p
    print(k,p)
print('ALL:',ok)
